title: Artificial general intelligence
description: Type of hypothetical AI with wide-ranging abilities
extract: Artificial general intelligence (AGI) is a hypothetical type of artificial intelligence that matches or surpasses human capabilities across most or all cognitive tasks. Unlike artificial narrow intelligence (ANI), whose competence is confined to well‑defined tasks, an AGI system can generalise knowledge, transfer skills between domains, and solve novel problems without task‑specific reprogramming.
